notes.title: Ghost Town announcement! A new VR puzzle adventure from the developers of The Room series!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33026102/2c78d9e9304c9a14d21e4d40a1b8321b9a0b02e2.gif[/img]

We're thrilled to announce [i][u][b]Ghost Town[/b][/u][/i], our new single-player puzzle adventure VR game! We've been working away on this for the past 4/5 years so it's super exciting for us to finally show it off!

[i]London, 1983. Edith Penrose, a witch turned ghost hunter, is kept busy running her paranormal detective agency. But after her brother goes missing Edith must draw upon her wits & supernatural talents to unravel the mystery.[/i]
[i]
Step in to the boots of Edith and explore an array of atmospheric locations using your trusty torch to light your way. Use the unique physicality of VR to overcome tactile puzzles, activate sigils and move troubled spirits on to the next world.[/i]

The store page is live now, with an announcement trailer & a few screenshots to whet the appetite! And why not add [i][b]Ghost Town[/b][/i] to your wishlist while you're over there! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496180/Ghost_Town/

notes.title: The Room: Old Sins - Coming to Steam February 11th!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1361320/The_Room_4_Old_Sins/

Since first releasing The Room 4: Old Sins on mobile and tablet devices back in 2017 there have been [i]countless requests[/i] for a PC version. Over the past year, despite a few disruptions here and there, we've created something we're incredibly proud of!

As with all our PC remasters, The Room 4: Old Sins has received a complete visual overhaul. Assets and environments have been completely re-built, re-textured and re-lit to bring the mysterious world of The Room to life.

We're super excited to share this game with you all next month. It's been a difficult year for everyone around the world, so we hope this announcement can act as a glimmer of good news! 

- Fireproof Games Team

notes.title: Additional language support for The Room VR: A Dark Matter
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36739529/b40d2fcb5fb86286297f19b63aa35d90f1bfee8f.jpg[/img]

After a successful launch, we've added a few more language options to the game - Russian, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese are now supported.

It's been about 5 months since we released The Room VR: A Dark Matter and we've truly been blown away by the response. Based on overall reviews, the game has achieved an "Overwhelmingly Positive" rating, keeping it in line with the other games in the series! The feedback is quite regularly shared among Fireproof team and is always lovely to see. 

Thanks to everyone who's purchased/reviewed the game so far!

- Fireproof Games

notes.title: The Room VR: A Dark Matter - RELEASE TOMORROW!!
notes.notes:
The Room VR: A Dark Matter is available on Steam as of [b]tomorrow[/b]! We're all set to hit the release button and can't wait to get it in to your headsets!

If you didn't know already - our Coming Soon Page is live now and from tomorrow, this is where you can purchase the game:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104380/The_Room_VR_A_Dark_Matter/

Though this isn't our first venture in to VR, it is the first time The Room series has received this treatment. The game has been specifically built from the ground up to make the most of what VR has to offer and it really does feel like a natural fit for the series. We're super proud of how it's turned out!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33026102/8e44cc8b6e791a2f95245eb8e5a9f55589293793.jpg[/img]

- Fireproof Games Team
